raw_response:
This small plot of mine is only about 0.16 hectares, and I am intercropping on it, so I use it mostly for our household food — groundnuts with a bit of other things mixed in. I save most of my FISP coupon fertilizer for the bigger maize plot where we need it most, so on this small plot I do not buy chemical fertilizer. I put some manure from our goats and chickens here, and I use seed I saved from last harvest because buying new seed every year is too expensive for a small plot like this. Since it is small and near the house, my daughter and I can manage the weeding and harvesting ourselves without hiring anyone.
